attrs.evidence: phase_pin_lint.py, called by run_case in BOTH negative runners before the forgery is judged; 9 battery cases carry an explicit HISTORY_PIN_OK reason and 4 that named the canonical revision by number were DERIVED (e.get('canonical')) and still catch their forgeries. harness_selftest M-10a..e: (a) the blindness MEASURED rather than argued -- a case pinned to today's canonical revision is applied, then canonicity is bumped to a synthetic next revision, and the same selector still mutates the file (so nothing existing objects) while no longer touching the canonical law; (b) the lint refuses a live phase pin; (c) the history exemption is honoured, so nine history cases are not forced to stop testing history; (d) a lint that cannot read its subject refuses to report clean, which is M-1's species inside the instrument added to catch a different one; (e) the pinned-polarity half. Harness 14/14.
attrs.statement: HISTORY MAY BE PINNED. LIVE STATE MUST BE DERIVED. An instrument whose intended subject is the LIVE, CURRENT or CANONICAL state may not LOCATE or CHARACTERISE that subject with a literal belonging to one phase -- a revision number, a version string, a count, or a boolean polarity. An instrument whose subject genuinely IS history may and SHOULD pin it, because deriving a historical subject makes it stop testing history; that case declares itself with an explicit exemption carrying a reason. THE FAILURE MODE IS SILENCE, WHICH IS WHY IT NEEDS A GUARD OF ITS OWN. A phase-pinned case is not VACUOUS -- a superseded revision still exists, so the mutation really changes a file -- and its declared TARGET still matches, and the clean baseline is still clean. Every other apparatus check passes. The case has simply stopped testing the thing it names, and the two available outcomes are a failure that reads like an engine defect, or nothing at all when a neighbouring assertion happens to catch the mutation anyway. FOUR INSTANCES IN TWO ROUNDS EARNED THIS LAW, and they are recorded rather than summarised because the shape is easier to recognise than to define: (1) grid_check required lowering_spike.inputs_model.implemented === false, correct while the port was open and, once B2 built it, the mechanism preventing the record from admitting the port had closed -- four passes stale; (2) the negative case guarding it forged implemented=True and expected 'must stay false', so the BATTERY enforced the stale value and 298/298 stayed green over a record contradicting the code; (3) grid_check selected the canonical film law by revision === 3, hand-edited on every supersession; (4) three battery cases selected revision == 3, and when @4 became canonical they went on mutating a superseded revision nothing asserts over and reported their own forgeries as UNCAUGHT. THE RULE IS NOT 'NO LITERALS IN EXPECTATIONS', which would be too blunt: implementation-provenance@1 must stay on the record AS a false claim, and film.native-emission@1 carries a readback record no later revision repeats. Those are correct BECAUSE they are pinned. The distinguishing question is what the instrument's SUBJECT is, not whether a number appears in it. AND THE CATALOGUE STAYS BOUNDED. This is the TENTH species in harness_selftest, added because the class repeated and not because it might; the guard is a narrow lint over the two negative runners, not a general analyzer for every way a test can be written badly. Ten, and then stop until an eleventh actually appears.
